    idx += 1
    queries = input_data[idx:]

    for i in range(H):
        base = i * W
        for j in range(W - 1):
            u = base + j
            v = base + j + 1
            w = F[u] if F[u] < F[v] else F[v]
            edges.append((w, u, v))
            
    for i in range(H - 1):
        base = i * W
        next_base = (i + 1) * W
        for j in range(W):

            edges.append((w, u, v))

        while i != parent[i]:
            parent[i] = parent[parent[i]]
            i = parent[i]
        return i

    left_child = [-1] * (2 * V)
    right_child = [-1] * (2 * V)
